propositions: The fit/dedup-key derivation in outbound_comments.py has no construct-uniqueness guard to prevent duplicate implementations merging without test failure, despite being one of five historical offenders in the defect review motivating the parent epic.

A test must scan src/rebar (except outbound_comments.py) for any function body containing both a fit call (fit_comment, sanitize_comment, or fit_preserving_marker) AND a to_wire call in the same scope, rejecting unmarked duplicates and requiring non-empty reason text on the escape marker.
The Cloud adapter's add_comment contains a legitimate second fit-then-wire composition that must be marked with a reasoned # comment-fit-ok: comment to pass the guard.
Mutation evidence must verify the guard: unmarked duplicate fails, duplicate with reasoned marker passes, duplicate with bare reasonless marker fails.
The guard uses atom conjunction (both fit AND to_wire in same function), not single tokens, to avoid false positives on innocent reconciler code.
